description: This file defines the code-behind logic for the AdminPanel page of an Online Examination System, including event handlers for button clicks to navigate between pages.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminPanel page handling navigation events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the Home button is clicked; currently no action defined.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the AdminQueue page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the AdminLeaderboard page when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the SetExam page when the start exam button is clicked.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the EditExam page when the edit exam button is clicked.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the LoginPage when the logout button is clicked.
